The '''1993–94 Bundesliga''' was the 31st season of the [[Bundesliga]], Germany's premier football league. It began on 6 August 1993<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.dfb.de/index.php?id=323106 |title=Schedule Round 1 |publisher=DFB |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20110608092334/https://www.dfb.de/index.php?id=323106 |archive-date=8 June 2011 }}</ref> and ended on 7 May 1994.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.dfb.de/index.php?id=323468 |title=Archive 1993/1994 Round 34 |publisher=DFB |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20110608092457/https://www.dfb.de/index.php?id=323468 |archive-date=8 June 2011 }}</ref> [[SV Werder Bremen]] were the defending champions.

== Teams ==
[[VfL Bochum]], [[KFC Uerdingen 05|Bayer 05 Uerdingen]] and [[1. FC Saarbrücken]] were relegated to the [[1993–94 2. Bundesliga|2. Bundesliga]] after finishing in the last three places. They were replaced by [[SC Freiburg]], [[MSV Duisburg]] and [[Lokomotive Leipzig|VfB Leipzig]].
